integrity: Exact discrete-time Markov occupation counts and all claimed asymptotic bounds are analytically derived; executable finite and high-precision tests are corroborative, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed population N≥4 and strictly partial reward cutoff 2≤t≤N−2; uniform asymptotics only on compact incentive subsets above the game disadvantage. No joint large-population limit or mutation; publication priority not independently established.
title: Two-barrier strong-selection law for threshold-funded cooperation
